title: 한국해양과학기술원법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Receipt of Donations)
(1) Where KIOST receives money or other property donated pursuant to Article 18 (1) and (2) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as "donations"), it shall issue a receipt to the donor: Provided, That a receipt need not be issued for an anonymous donation or where the donor cannot be identified.
(2) Where KIOST receives donations under paragraph (1), it may enter into an agreement, as publicly notified by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, if the donor so wishes or if necessary for the efficient management of the donations. <Amended on March 24, 2013>
